instruction: Search Steam for Counter-Strike 2 and include it in your shopping cart.

metadata.explanation: Task variation: User needs to search for Counter-Strike 2 on Steam and add it to cart. Evaluator uses existing is_added_to_steam_cart metric to check if Counter-Strike 2 appears in the cart page content. This follows the same pattern as the original Dota 2 task with a different game. No custom functions needed - reuses existing Chrome getters/metrics. Note: CS2 is free-to-play, so the instruction focuses on adding the base game to cart.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Instruction requires 'add Counter-Strike 2 to cart' and evaluator correctly checks if 'Counter-Strike 2' appears in cart page content
Getter logic is correct: get_page_info navigates to Steam cart URL (https://store.steampowered.com/cart/) and extracts page title, URL, and HTML content
Metric logic is correct: is_added_to_steam_cart performs simple string search for each item in rule['items'] within the page content, returning 1.0 if all items found
Expected value is semantically correct: items=['Counter-Strike 2'] matches the game name that should appear in cart after successful addition
Runtime feasibility verified: Getter can access cart page state, metric can search HTML content, and expected value matches actual game name
